TanStack Router loader ensureQueryData.description:
Fill the query cache before the route renders, so the component's query resolves synchronously. Requires a queryClient on the router context and a queryOptions factory.

在路由渲染前填充查询缓存，使组件中的查询同步命中；需要 router context 上的 queryClient，以及一个 queryOptions 工厂。

TanStack Router loader prefetchQuery.description:
Start a slow query without blocking the navigation while awaiting the one the first paint needs. Requires a queryClient on the router context.

不阻塞导航地启动较慢的查询，同时 await 首屏所需的那个；需要 router context 上的 queryClient。

TanStack Router route with suspense quer.description:
Preload in the loader and read the same query in the component, so the data is never pending on first render. Requires createFileRoute from @tanstack/react-router, useSuspenseQuery from @tanstack/react-query and a queryClient on the router context.

在 loader 预取、在组件中读取同一个查询，首次渲染便不会处于 pending；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createFileRoute、@tanstack/react-query 的 useSuspenseQuery，以及 router context 上的 queryClient。

TanStack Router queryClient in router co.description:
Type the router context so every loader can reach the query client. The same client must be passed to createRouter as context and to QueryClientProvider. Requires createRootRouteWithContext from @tanstack/react-router and the QueryClient type from @tanstack/react-query.

为 router context 声明类型，使所有 loader 都能取到 query client；同一个 client 必须同时传给 createRouter 的 context 与 QueryClientProvider；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createRootRouteWithContext，以及 @tanstack/react-query 的 QueryClient 类型。

TanStack Router SSR query integration.description:
Build one router and one query client per request and let them share dehydration. Requires createRouter from @tanstack/react-router, QueryClient from @tanstack/react-query and setupRouterSsrQueryIntegration from @tanstack/react-router-ssr-query.

每个请求创建一套 router 与 query client 并共享脱水数据；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createRouter、@tanstack/react-query 的 QueryClient，以及 @tanstack/react-router-ssr-query 的 setupRouterSsrQueryIntegration。
